description: 放課後、3人の高校生が学校の温室で植物の成長を調査している。中央の男子生徒は定規を使ってトマトの苗の高さを測り、記録用紙に数値を書き込んでいる。左側の女子生徒はじょうろでハーブの苗に水を与えながら葉の状態を確認している。右側の女子生徒はタブレットを使って植物の写真を撮り、成長記録を入力している。温室内にはトマト、ハーブ、花、苗、植物ラベル、温度計、園芸道具などが整理されており、3人が協力して植物の成長条件を調べている。
imagePrompt: A high-quality, detailed illustration designed for an IELTS or Eiken English speaking picture-description test. Show exactly three teenage students conducting a plant-growth investigation inside a bright modern Japanese high school greenhouse after school. Do not include any additional visible people. The atmosphere should be educational, calm, cooperative, scientific, and positive. In the center foreground, a teenage boy wearing a school uniform with his sleeves rolled up is carefully measuring the height of a young tomato plant with a long ruler. He is holding a clipboard with a simple data sheet and writing down the measurement with a pencil. The ruler, tomato plant, clipboard, and measuring action must all be clearly visible. On the left side, a teenage girl wearing a school uniform and a simple gardening apron is watering several small herb seedlings with a watering can. At the same time, she is leaning slightly toward one plant and examining its leaves for color and condition. On the right side, another teenage girl is holding a tablet correctly with the screen facing her. She is taking a photograph of a row of plants and entering growth observations into a simple digital chart. The three activities must be visually distinct and easy to describe: one student measuring plant height and recording data, one student watering and examining leaves, and one student photographing plants and entering information on a tablet. Surround them with visually rich but organized greenhouse details: rows of tomato plants supported by stakes, basil and mint seedlings, flowering plants, seedling trays, plant labels, pots, bags of soil, gardening gloves, a hand trowel, pruning scissors placed safely on a workbench, a spray bottle, a thermometer, a humidity gauge, a small fan, shelves, and transparent greenhouse walls and roof. Show warm late-afternoon sunlight coming through the glass and green school grounds outside. Include a simple experiment board with icons for sunlight, water, temperature, and plant growth, but no important readable text. Clear foreground, middle ground, and background. Exactly three visible people. No additional people, no animals, no speech bubbles, no brand logos, no copyrighted characters. Landscape 16:9 composition, clean colorful educational illustration style, realistic proportions, highly detailed but uncluttered, expressive natural body language, suitable for an English speaking assessment.

sentences.text: The three students are conducting a systematic investigation into plant growth under controlled greenhouse conditions.
sentences.ja: 3人の生徒は管理された温室環境で植物の成長について体系的な調査を行っています。

sentences.text: The male student is quantifying the height of a tomato specimen and documenting the measurement on a data sheet.
sentences.ja: 男子生徒はトマトの苗の高さを数値化し、その測定値をデータシートに記録しています。

sentences.text: His careful procedure suggests that the measurements are being collected systematically over a period of time.
sentences.grammar: suggest that / 現在進行受動態
sentences.ja: 彼の慎重な手順から、測定値が一定期間にわたって体系的に収集されていることがうかがえます。

sentences.text: One of his classmates is maintaining adequate moisture while closely monitoring the condition of the foliage.
sentences.ja: クラスメートの一人は、葉の状態を注意深く観察しながら適切な水分量を保っています。

sentences.text: She appears to be assessing whether the seedlings are thriving under the current growing conditions.
sentences.ja: 彼女は現在の生育条件で苗が順調に育っているか評価しているようです。

sentences.text: Meanwhile, the third student is creating a visual record of the experiment and entering her observations on a tablet.
sentences.ja: その一方で、3人目の生徒は実験の視覚記録を作り、観察結果をタブレットに入力しています。

sentences.text: The thermometer, humidity gauge, and labeled plants indicate that several environmental variables are being monitored.
sentences.grammar: indicate that / 現在進行受動態
sentences.ja: 温度計、湿度計、ラベル付き植物から、複数の環境条件が観察されていることが分かります。

sentences.text: By combining measurements, photographs, and direct observations, the students can compare how different cultivation conditions affect development.
sentences.ja: 測定、写真、直接観察を組み合わせることで、生徒たちは異なる栽培条件が成長にどう影響するか比較できます。

sentences.text: The scene illustrates how practical scientific research can develop observation, data-analysis, and collaborative problem-solving skills.
sentences.ja: この場面は、実践的な科学研究によって観察力、データ分析力、協働的な問題解決力を育てられることを示しています。
